source.title: Error source
source.description: Discriminates errors generated by the ingress from the terminal outcome of the invocation. 'ingress' errors carry a Restate-controlled HTTP status code following the usual HTTP semantics, while 'invocation' errors carry a user-controlled status code. Also available in the 'x-restate-error-source' response header.
